packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates once CI passes
Major updates: open a PR for manual review, never automerge
docker/docker uses +incompatible versioning Renovate cannot resolve (module github.com/docker/docker vs repo moby/moby, no /vN path); bump it manually via `go get`.
The go directive is the module's minimum language version, not the build toolchain; keep it manual.
Go toolchain patches carry stdlib security fixes (govulncheck fails CI until they land): skip the release-age wait and automerge.
